about: The apothecary's loft as the room checks know it (tools/blender/room_checks). Since G2b the checks read the room's numbers from the builder's manifest and the scene (roomcfg.Facts); this file holds only the failures listed for the owner.

known_fails.why: 58 of the map's 59 walkable tiles can be stood on. (9,7) lies under Mallory's bed (a day bed, north to south at the under-bed hide's tile (9,6), its foot to the south wall). The same kind as the bedroom's, the parlour's and the cottage's tiles under their beds; listed for the owner (2026-11-21), not yet ruled on.

known_fails_note: summary.py marks these as known in summary.json. They still count: run.sh ends non-zero while any check fails.
